en: Aren't I? Either I'm a dumb goblin, or I'm a piece of jewelry! I don't know which thought is more disgusting!
Because you're one of my men, Borf, and I don't leave my people behind. It doesn't need to be any more complicated than that.
Borf!
Borf! You're gonna be alright!
Borf, it's not your fault. You tried.
Borf, most of us are criminals, and all of us are exiles. I'm sure most people back in Crest would see the whole lot of us as nothing but dumb animals.
Can we get moving? Bato had some venison he was going to cook tonight, and I'd rather not miss it.
Can we get moving? I don't want to be here anymore, and I'm starting to really miss my tent right about now.
Dammit, Borf, we don't have a lot of choice here! We're going to have to fight them!
Fuck it all! You brought this on yourselves!
Hey, I know what'll cheer you up. I've got a flank of venison back at the stronghold I was saving for a special occasion. I think maybe tonight's the night.
I don't want you to have to die! This is your last chance! Just run!
I know that! Dammit, why won't they listen?
I'm really looking forward to getting out of this rain. We should finish up and go.
If they had just walked away, they'd all still be alive. Surely even a dumb animal could figure that out.
Isn't this... the way it was... supposed to be? Now... the goblins... are dead.
Just dumb animals. That's really all they are, isn't it? Is that all I am too?
Let's get moving. Bato had some venison he was going to cook tonight, and I've been fantasizing about it all day.
Maybe you're right. Sorry.
One of Us
Sure, Borf.
Sure, Borf. Let's go.
That sounds good, Bato. I'm looking forward to it.
That sounds good, Bato. Thanks.

Those goblins came up against the wrong targets today, but they didn't wallow in their doubts searching for some perfect identity. They lived their lives the way they wanted, and they ended their lives the same way.
Whether you think that puts you in good company or not is up to you, but the way I see it, you're one of us, and just like us, it's up to you to either own it, or to rise above it.
Who Cares?
Who cares? Do you think anybody else has that figured out either?
Why... bother? I... am no different... from them.
Why? Why couldn't I make them listen?
You aren't like that Borf.
You guys really don't know who you're messing with here! Turn around and leave! Nobody has to get hurt!
You know, I've got a flank of venison back at the stronghold I was saving for a special occasion. I think maybe tonight's the night.
You should give them a little more credit. Maybe, you spending all your time worrying about who you are and what you should be means the stupid one here is you.
You're right. Thanks for helping me sort it out.
Ah! It's too hot!
All my wounds, my losses, my scars. They're worth it, for leading me to you.
Always. Lead the way!
And what on earth is that noise?
Anyway, I'm beat. See you in the morning.
Bring me low, you damn fool!
Chief? What are you doing out of bed?
Getting here was a harder hike than I'm used to. It looked promising from that watchtower, but I don't think this place is stronghold material.
I got worried when you didn't come back, and then I heard that noise. Are you alright?
I haven't ever met a man like you before. The things I feel when I watch you fight, or when I feel your eyes on my skin, they are savage and desperate in ways I can't describe.
I just wanted to make sure you were alright. It sounds like you know what you're doing, so I'm going back to bed.
I know you aren't Tsarathi, so I wouldn't expect you to know about those, but you probably get the idea by now that orc cities have way too many men and not enough women.
I need to drag my tusks through the hair of your chest and forge us into a single flesh!
I never imagined I'd meet such an amazing woman on this island, of all places. You are beautiful and powerful, and I crave you like the night sky craves the sun.
I slept really well, thanks. Ready for another day on the road?
I thought there might be enough life left in it to get it running one more time, so I opened the valves and lit the furnace.
I was one of those boys. No idea who my parents are, because I was raised by captains and swordsmen.
I'm ready. Let's go.
I'm sorry.
Iday, Bru. Slept well?
Iday, Brudum. Slept well?
It's a military school, or at least it used to be. I grew up in one just like it back in Tsarath.
It's hard to tell for sure without daylight, but I think you're right.
Let's find out if I'm lucky or not.
Nazar!
No, no, don't get me wrong! It's a very typical upbringing for an orc boy, and I look back on it fondly. I have some very special memories of that school, and this place reminds me of that.
Of course I do.
Of course. Goodnight Nazar.
See you in the morning, I guess.
Shall we go, Id Brudum?
Shut up and kiss me, Nazar.
So why are you naked?
Sure thing. I won't be too much longer anyhow.
Surrender them?
Tell me you feel this too! Tell me you need to command my flesh as badly as I need to command yours!
That's right. Just hand 'em over and never look back. One less mouth to feed, one less kid to pay attention to.
The water will last longer if we share.
This place felt familiar to me ever since we got here. It was bugging me, and I couldn't shake it, so I decided to come take a look.
This place has a rainwell and a boiler. It's old, but the school where I grew up had a setup just like it.
Too hot is perfect!
We're lucky we found this place all the way out here. I wouldn't call it luxury, but it beats sleeping on the ground.
Well enough. Let's pack up and get moving.
Well, in order to make things easier on parents trying to conceive girls, they have these military schools where you can go and just surrender boys of any age.
What are you doing here?
What do you think? Worth it, right?
Why don't you leave your clothes by the door and come find out?
Worth it. You haven't disappointed me yet!
Yeah, of course, I'm fine. Didn't mean to make you worry.
Yeah. I figure that it will.
You embrace the world like a brazen, naked beast, and I cannot help but stare. Your immodesty excites me.
You parade your naked body before me again and again, and my hunger for you grows more ferocious by the day!
You really do trust me, don't you?
Your breasts are magnificent. I can scarcely push their image out of my mind.

Please be courteous and leave the shelter as clean as you found it.

-Royal Highway Commission
Ah, this place brings back memories. If I had a coin for every night I've spent in a bandit fort, I'd be a rich man!
Anyway, what's the plan? We camping here?
Well, maybe not too rich. I could afford a new shirt, at least.
. It's a song about remembering home, even when you're far away, and about being able to find your way back.
And does Lukatt feel like home to you?
Anyway, we'll camp here for tonight, but let's not build the fire inside. It'll smoke us out before morning for sure.
But that's fine. I get moments like these, and I am happy.
Do you hear it? The timbre of this old building is great.
Do you know what it's called?
Do you want to go home, Rosaline?

Everybody needs a home, don't they? The poor family that sold me to a dance troupe sure isn't it. The people who raised me to be a killer aren't it either. Now, here, surrounded by outcasts and monsters...
For what it's worth, I know how you feel. I'm gevaudan. Do you know what that means?
Hey, I haven't seen Wisaka in a little while. Did you see where he went?
Hmm? Oh sorry, I was distracted. This place has a really interesting sound to it, don't you think?
Huh. That's such a simple question. I wish the answer could be that simple.
I don't really hear anything, but you hear a lot better than I do, so you're probably right.
I get to wear nicer clothes, though. Grant can look human enough, but he dresses in rags that he can just tie back on after he explodes out of them.

I heard it once, a long time ago. A woman was singing it over the body of a dead man, her husband, I think. I hadn't properly learned the language at the time so I couldn't understand the words, but her voice cut through me, and I never forgot it.
I just have more questions, and no satisfying answers at all. Sorry, Wisaka.
I'm okay with it if you guys are. Wisaka?
I'm pretty sure he didn't leave. I'll see if he's inside.
I, however, cannot shapeshift at all. What you see is what you get, so unlike other werewolves, I can't blend in with humans no matter how hard I try.
Is this home? Could it be? Can someone like me ever find a place that feels like home?
It means I'm a werewolf more than once, basically. Neither of my parents were werewolves, but they were both carriers, so I got a double dose.
It's called
It's not all bad, though. I don't wreck my clothes every five minutes like some other werewolves do.
It's... hard to say. No satisfying answer, I suppose.
No, I've never heard the word before. What does it mean?
Of course! Anything for an audience!
Seems somehow fitting that I'd hear it again in a place like this.
That song! I haven't heard that song since I was a little girl. Since before I started training to be a dancer.
The building is in good shape. It's a shame it's so small.
Would you play the song again?
You think it'll be alright for us for tonight?
You've probably seen Grant shapeshifting, right? He's quite good at it.
Alright, fine. You're obviously not with them, so if you're just travelling the road, travel it away from me.
Hey now, this weren't my plan! You can keep your gold!
I said empty your purse, you deaf cow! Of course, if you'd prefer, we can always just pick the coins out of the mess of your corpse.
More? How many of you must I kill before you leave me in peace?
That is what I thought you said.
What... what in the... you killed Samwell!
You want to say that again? I didn't quite hear you.
A frog told me that something dangerous is coming, and I don't care to find out what. You want the hut, you can have it.
Come to loot and destroy, have you? Well, be my guest. I was just leaving anyhow.
What? Is someone there?
A sad day then. At least I'll get to die surrounded by my treasures.
Ack! How did you get in here!?
I've tried to be civil, and those hits really did hurt, but finishing me off isn't that easy. Now I'll just be taking my stuff back and be on my way.

Oh deary me, trying to steal from my collection are we. Just because you thought you killed me, you think that this place now belongs to you? While I may not be a fighter, I have survived here for quite a while.
There you go. Everything else in here is too sentimental for me to part with, and wouldn't be useful to you anyhow. So please just leave and never come back.
Very good, very good. Now wait here a tick, will you? You're going to like this.
Well, I know better than to fight when I'm outmatched. If you let me go, I'll give you some good things from my plunders. What do you say?
... I don't intend to let your shoulders go cold ever again.
Am I going mad with worry? Perhaps. Are they dreams, or are they visions? Perhaps this is Leviathan sending me madness to punish my lapse.
And... it's not without its appeals.
Another life I'm glad to be rid of. This life is harder, but it's real.
Echo through ...... our love

Generations ago, long before the days of my grandmother's mother, Lukatt was a hive of beasts and worse. Orcs and men came to conquer it, but no matter how ferociously they struggled, the island always brought them low.
Gloried one ...... sea
Gloried... he... hear... voices... echo... love
He mouths the same word over and over again. Bertan. Pertan. Mortan. Purtan. I can't make it out clearly. Why does it seem so important?
Hear our voices, ...... above

I have revealed the secret to two others before now: my Lord-husband, and my prime minister. They strive now to find some way to appease Leviathan and spare us all. Hopefully the focus on me and my deeds will afford them some fortune.
I hold a secret forbidden to ever pass my lips, but this telling of it shall be my third. I only hope that by the time someone finds this regretful tome, its knowledge will be unnecessary.
I remember how much pain you were in. A stone that large might've killed you!
I see a man's body, perfect in every way, but broken into many pieces, black and glittering. His head, broken away from his body tries to speak, but no air passes his lips.
I was sewing a cloak for you. To keep your shoulders warm when I could not. It is unfinished, but...
I was. Please, take it!
Id krav oraidumten, Nazar.
If they fail, then I will have truly been the queen to destroy Lukatt, in a far fuller sense than anyone can imagine. Lord Leviathan, have mercy upon us.
In return, Leviathan would allow his chosen few, the Lukattites, to flourish, to build upon the island, and he would protect and nurture them as a part of the island itself.
It couldn't... you mean all that time you were sick, you... you were holding a Bogani stone? For me...?

It is a stone of my own flesh, and it is my promise of faith 
to you. Accept it, and I will belong to you evermore, in flesh and blood, in love and war. I desire no other.
It's so peaceful here. Like nothing bad ever happened here at all.
It's so warm. I don't know what to say! I never imagined somebody would think me worthy of something like this. How can I possibly repay this?
It's yes, you fool! That was our last kiss as idle lovers.
Leviathan will be angered, and this island will be doomed.
Lord Leviathan ......

Many Lukattites call for my blood, and my words are widely mocked as lies. If I am killed, the bargain will go unhonoured. If I reveal this secret to my people, they will think that I am spinning a fantastic yarn to save my own head.

Maxim is mounting an expedition at his hunting lodge in Pagewood, hoping to treat with Leviathan himself, and Fastad has retreated to his archive in Bracewind to search for other solutions. All of my hopes rest on them.
Nazar, it's beautiful. Thank you.
Never. Not when the end of the day promised me back to you.
Since meeting you, I have thought of little else. Whatever happens here, whatever becomes of this island, I don't ever want to lose you.
The greatest of the terrors was Leviathan, his coils tangled around every reef and shoal. The island belonged to him, and he would not lightly release it.

The hero, Chevre, went low into the bowels of the island, and there, he struck a bargain with the lord of the island's monsters. Rites, sacrifices, festivals in his honour, those were the promises made.

This bargain was kept secret, so as to prevent our enemies from interfering with it, and its terms were passed from Chevre, who became the island's first king, to each monarch in succession. Now, the burden of this bargain rests with me.
This kingdom is fallen, and my people torn. My life is in danger, so I have fled here, to the cloister I once lived as a young girl. Even here is not safe, however, and soon, nowhere will be safe.
This kiss shall be as your husband.
What is your answer then?
What's this?
Yeah. There are some things on this island that make all of the bad stuff seem really far away. Like another life.
You can repay it by laying with me every night and standing with me every day, until time or battle takes us.
You... you what?
all time

high
in sunken
is he
praised be
the brine
And thanks.
Bigs! Bigs coming! Protect King!
I've got to get out of this place. As for you, sack it, loot it, claim it, or burn it to the ground for all I care. If there's anything of use to you, it's all yours. I just want out.

It worked, I suppose, for they were certainly in awe of me, but then they dragged me back here and said I was their king. They didn't ever plan to let me leave, and there were far more than I could hope to overcome alone, so I had no choice but to play along.
My name is Shapiro, and I am... or was... a professor of sorcery. When I came under attack by these creatures, naturally I used my sorcery to defend myself.
Oh thank the Gods. Did you get them all?
Rest assured, I have no love for these diminuitive savages, and I was never their king.
If there was anyone I'd want to see just one more time, Max, it would be you.
Max. I remember when these sculptures were made. You probably think I'm lying, but the sculptor really didn't exaggerate much.
Anyway, can I have it? I'm the only one with any chance of withstanding the pure darkness of that cake, after all.
But, of course!
Dark arcane secrets, what else?
I really thought the cake would be chocolate, though. Strange.
I'm uniquely-suited and such.
It isn't working! It's rebellious! Like the darkness has a will of its own!
Just get your rod, and let's go.
Let's see what this rod can do!
Man was not meant to know chocolate as dark as this!
My moment of weakness is past. Best that you carry the cake back to the stronghold though, lest I be tempted.
No matter. It is only a matter of time before its secrets bend to my will. Let's be off.
Oh no! While we were screwing around with that cake, some trolls wandered up!
Oh, drat! I got so caught up in the excitement of battle, I completely forgot to pick up the rod!
Oh, no no no. You can't feel it? Look at this masterpiece!
Oh, they'll be sorry they came this way today.
Perhaps, in the end, that is the wiser choice. Who knows what could happen if I unraveled the moist, dark secrets of that eldritch wonder?
Right. Well. Let's go then.
Rosewood Teahouse Menu
Seriously? Lots of people back at the stronghold would love to have some cake too. I get that you're desperate for it, but really, I thought you'd be more willing to share.
So you intend to deny me the power, then?
Such magnificent power!
The loft! The crumb! The heady aroma! The fine, pure cocoa! It's positively bewitching!
This is the weirdest thing I've seen since we got here. Even when compared to that thing with the face.
This rod contains all of the power of that cake. I'm sure we'll be able to find a way to turn its power toward the greater good.
This thing could make enough cake to feed everybody forever!
Unbelievable! To think that this was just sitting here all these years!
Unbelieveable!
Wait, Greening, what are you doing?
Watch, I'll make a gigantic one right now!
What the hell was that?
What's wrong?
What? It's just a cake.

Lord Leviathan is he.

echo through the brine our love."
